chart.legendCusp: Sign boxes are fixed (South Indian). Framed label = Placidus house beginning (cusp); grey = graha. KP houses are not sign boxes — one sign can hold two cusps and one house can span two signs. ʳ retrograde.
chart.legendTransit: Sign boxes are fixed (South Indian). Grey label = graha (sky position at the transit moment). No house beginnings (cusps) are drawn on this chart: KP transit is the sky at a single moment. ʳ retrograde.
chart.cuspTitle: Beginning of house {house} (Placidus cusp) · {pos} · sub lord {sub}

kp.localNumberNote: * The KP number was taken from the KP sub-division table (KP Reader I rule, 249 numbers): this point lies in the second part of a sub-division that is split at a sign boundary; the calculation service reported the number of the first part. Longitude, sign, star, sub and sub-sub lords are the same as the service's; only the number was corrected.

plain.label: Plain 4 levels (node agency not applied)
plain.detail: The node is read like an ordinary graha: L1 the house of its star lord, L2 its own house, L3 the houses owned by its star lord; since a node owns no sign, L4 is empty. In this calculation the nodes are described as 'agents of the sign lord', but the agent houses are not added to the table.
plain.status: Independently verified (with birth chart and horary examples).

agent.label: 4 levels with agents (node + sign lord + grahas in the same sign + grahas in the 7th sign)
agent.detail: The houses its agents signify at the same level are added to the node's own levels. Agents = sign lord + grahas in the same sign as the node + grahas in the 7th sign from the node. Conjunction and opposition are sign-based: a graha 19.5° away in the same sign counts as an agent, one 2.8° away in the neighbouring sign does not. The special aspects of Jupiter (9th), Saturn (3rd) and Mars (4th) are not counted. Because Ketu is always in Rahu's 7th sign, 'aspect from the 7th sign' and 'conjunction with the opposite node' give the same result.
agent.status: Independently verified (3 births, 6 node lists). The aspects of Jupiter (5th), Saturn (10th) and Mars (8th) were not tested separately.

agent_houses.label: Agent houses: houses occupied + owned by the node and its agents (no levels; no star levels)
agent_houses.detail: At this endpoint the node's list is only the L2 (occupied houses) and L4 (owned houses) part of the agent rule. The L1/L3 houses coming from the star lord are not added. Order: first the node's own house, then the conjunct / 7th-sign agents, the sign lord last. For visible grahas this endpoint gives all 4 levels. The calculation documentation only says '4-level KP hierarchy' for this technique; it does not describe the difference for nodes.
agent_houses.status: Independently verified (2 births, 3 lists, including order). An implementation not defined in the calculation documentation (undocumented).

kp.nodeLegendFoot: The chart, dasha and ruling calculations use different rules for the nodes; so the house list of the same node can differ between the chart, dasha and ruling screens. The lists are not converted into one another.

sig.title: Significators (KP 4 levels)
sig.note: L1 = grahas in the star of the house occupant (strongest) · L2 = grahas in the house · L3 = grahas in the star of the house owner · L4 = house owner (cusp sign lord).
sig.noteHorary: In horary the table shows the plain rule for the nodes; houses marked with a blue '+' come from the list with agents in the same calculation result.

ruling.title: KP ruling planets
ruling.moment: {utc} UTC ({local} at the birth offset) · observation place
ruling.omitted: Because the observation place differs from the birthplace, natal significators are not shown in this calculation: at this endpoint the provider also builds the natal chart at the observation place, which would be the wrong location. For natal significators use the "KP birth chart" technique or calculate the ruling planets at the birthplace.
ruling.legacy: Warning: in this older record the observation place differs from the birthplace; the significators below were calculated from the observation-place chart instead of the birthplace and must not be used as natal significators.
ruling.sigTitle: Natal significators of the ruling planets (order of strength)
ruling.methodNote: Ruling planets are given in calculation order (strongest to weakest). The set is built from the classical 5 elements: day lord (vara, based on sunrise), Moon sign + star lord, Lagna sign + star lord. Sub and sub-sub lords are shown but do not join the set. The Lagna is that of the calculation moment and the observation place (not the natal Lagna).
ruling.sigNote: Significators are the houses each ruling planet signifies in the birth chart (provider's order of strength); calculated with the birth data and birthplace.

focus.openTitle: Open the KP chart in a large view that fits the screen

transit.title: KP transit
transit.partial: For that moment this technique gives the sky with the KP hierarchy (star / sub / sub-sub lord); house placement relative to the natal cusps and transit–natal relationship analysis are NOT part of this technique and Yaşam Sistemi does not calculate them. Western transits and Vedic Gochara are separate techniques.

horary.title: KP horary · number {n}
horary.numberRule: The number (1–249) selects one of the KP sub-divisions of the zodiac; the horary Lagna is the MIDPOINT of that segment. The only value on the chart that comes from the number is the Lagna: the other 11 cusps come from this Lagna at the latitude of the evaluation place (Placidus), and the planets come from the real sky at the question moment. Birth data is not used.
horary.rulingRule: Ruling planets are read from the REAL (time) Lagna of the question moment, not from the number's Lagna. The order is the provider's (strongest to weakest). The classical five elements: day lord (Hindu day, from sunrise), the Moon's sign and star lord, the sign and star lord of the time Lagna. Sub lords do not join the set; they are shown for information only.
horary.cuspSubRule: Each row: the cusp's sub lord and the significator houses of that graha in the same calculation (L1 strongest … L4 weakest). Which houses count as supportive for which question depends on the school and the practitioner; Yaşam Sistemi makes no positive/negative judgement.
horary.nodeRule: If the sub lord is Rahu/Ketu the table shows the plain rule; houses marked with '+' come from the list with agents in the same response.
horary.source: Source: the KP horary (1–249) calculation of our calculation infrastructure. The tables are a rearrangement of that calculation's response; there is no new calculation.
horary.lagnasTitle: Two Lagnas: the number's Lagna and the question moment's Lagna
horary.differs: In this question the two Lagnas differ.
horary.same: In this question the lords of the two Lagnas are the same.
horary.lagnaRule: Cusps and houses are read from the number's Lagna, ruling planets from the question moment's Lagna; one is never used in place of the other.
horary.order: Order: sign lord → star lord → sub lord → sub-sub lord.
horary.cuspSubTitle: Cusp sub lords and the houses they signify

timing.title: KP Transit · time range
timing.note: Moments are received from the provider in UTC and shown in the selected zone (daylight saving time is applied separately for each moment). KP is read only through the KP number, the star (nakshatra) lord, the sub-lord and the rasi; Western aspects are not part of this view.
timing.missing: Parts that could not be calculated: {list}. The list is incomplete for these parts; running again requests only the missing ones.
timing.sublordNone: No Sub-Lord change in this range.
timing.providerCorrection: * At this change the provider reported the new KP number and sub-lord with the previous value (the new star lord was correct). The value was corrected consistently with the provider's next record and the independent KP table; the change moment is the provider's.
timing.splitCorrection: * In retrograde motion the row enters the second part of a sub-division split at a sign boundary; the calculation service reported the first part's number as the new KP number. The number was corrected from the KP sub-division table; the change moment and lords are the same as the service's.
timing.rasiNone: No rasi change in this range.

interval.title: KP ruling planets time scan
interval.window: {start} → {end} local ({off}) · {step} min step · {n} moments · observation place
interval.methodNote: Time-range scan: at each step the sky chart of that moment (Placidus) is built at the observation place; the significators are the houses in that moment's chart. This is a DIFFERENT method from the birth-chart (natal) significators of the “KP ruling planets” technique; the two tables must not be used in place of each other. Birth data is not used.
interval.ruleNote: The ruling planets set is the classical five elements: day lord (vara, changes at local sunrise), the Moon's sign and star lord, the Lagna's sign and star lord. Sub and sub-sub lords do not join the set; they are only shown.
interval.numberNote: No KP number (1–249) is given in this scan; the sign / star / sub / sub-sub lord chain is checked one by one against the KP sub-division table.
interval.noChanges: The lords did not change during the window.
interval.foot: Highlighted cell: the lord that changed since the previous moment. Significators are under each row's “Detail” button (that moment's chart).
interval.sigLead: Significators (that moment's chart, order of strength):

fields.tooMany: at most 121 moments (duration / step) — increase the step
fields.dstNote: If the observation place's UTC offset changes within the window (daylight saving time), no calculation is made.
